tasks.description:
NEW src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-prompts.test.ts. WHERE: src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-prompts.test.ts:43-53 EXPECTED: TR-003 guards the PROMPT.md the runtime actually dispatches. PluginLoader builds `builtInBase = path.join(import.meta.dirname, "builtins")` (src/plugins/loader.ts:274), which for the compiled entry point is `dist/plugins/builtins`. The suite must either resolve from the repo root and assert BOTH copies, or this phase's gate must carry `diff -q src/... dist/...`. ACTUAL: `HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))` pins all 57 cases to the `src/` copy. Phase 01's only `diff -q` is cli-vs-webapp — both under `src/`. REPRODUCED: restoring `dist/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-code-cli/PROMPT.md` from `a57a68f^` (D1 phase-wide force-complete `.tasks[].status) = "completed"` present, grep count 1) without rebuilding leaves 70/70 phase tests green, T001's inline gate exit 0 and T002-gate.sh exit 0 — while every live code review is dispatched the defective prompt. FIX: resolve PROMPT.md paths from the repo root and run the 57-case contract over `src/` and `dist/` as a matrix, or add `diff -q src/plugins/builtins/reviews/

/PROMPT.md dist/plugins/builtins/reviews/

/PROMPT.md` to this phase's gate. Do not defer to Phase 06 T009. GATE: T001 inline gateScript — no assertion covers dist/; gates/T001-gate.sh does not exist REF: plan.md Phase 01; spec.md TC-005 ("prompt changes go live via postbuild; dist/ is shared mutable state") REVIEW FAIL (code): the D9 negative guard is section-scoped and escapable — FR-002/TR-003. WHERE: src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-prompts.test.ts:260,278-284 EXPECTED: the banned doctrine "Using tasks.json status as primary verdict when gates exist (gates are truth)" is refused ANYWHERE in the prompt, like its sibling negatives which assert against `FLAT`/`PROMPT` (lines 118, 142, 146, 156, 180). ACTUAL: `const anti = flatten(mdSection(PROMPT, "## Anti-Patterns"))` scopes the assertion to one section. REPRODUCED: inserting that exact sentence into `` in BOTH twin prompts (so the cli/webapp `diff -q` still passes) leaves 57/57 green; same for ``. Those are the sections where the agent reads it with MORE authority than an anti-pattern bullet. FIX: assert this negative against `FLAT` (the whole flattened prompt), not `anti`. GATE: T001 inline gateScript — its D1 negatives are whole-file greps, but nothing covers the D9 text REF: plan.md Phase 01; spec.md FR-002 REVIEW FAIL (code): the new test file is published inside the live plugin tree — TC-005. WHERE: src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-prompts.test.ts:1 EXPECTED: the suite lives outside the tree `postbuild` copies verbatim into `dist/`, so no uncompiled `.ts` test importing `vitest` ships in the package. ACTUAL: package.json postbuild runs `cp -r src/plugins/builtins/* dist/plugins/builtins/`, and tsconfig excludes `**/*.test.ts`, so the copy is the only path in. VERIFIED: `dist/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-prompts.test.ts` exists (13545 bytes) and `files: ["dist/", ...]` publishes it, inside the tree `PluginLoader.listPlugins` scans (loader.ts:184). grep -q` is exempt from `set -e` and can never fail a gate. if grep -q 'tasks\[\].status) = "completed"' src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-code-cli/PROMPT.md; then echo 'FAIL: D1 phase-wide force-complete is back in review-code-cli' >&2; exit 1; fi if grep -q 'tasks\[\].status) = "completed"' src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-code-webapp/PROMPT.md; then echo 'FAIL: D1 phase-wide force-complete is back in review-code-webapp' >&2; exit 1; fi if grep -q 'note them in your summary but do NOT change its status' src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts; then echo 'FAIL: the D10 sentence is back in the scope context' >&2; exit 1; fi # Named-case existence: a `-t` filter exits 0 on no match, so assert against the test source instead. grep -q 'tells the review agent that re-opening the task is the NO-GO' src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts grep -q "no longer tells it to leave a completed task's status alone" src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts grep -q 'still forbids touching tasks from other phases' src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts grep -q "readVerdict's doc comment states the real rule" src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts): The review agent re-opened this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing. NOTE (retry, iteration 2): the prompt-contract suite moved to src/engine/review-prompts.test.ts — `postbuild` copies src/plugins/builtins/* into dist/ verbatim and `files: ["dist/"]` publishes it, so the old location shipped an uncompiled vitest file inside the live plugin tree (TC-005). The declared gateScript delegates to gates/T00X-gate.sh, which is the artifact runTaskGate actually executes; the shared assertions live in gates/phase-01-contract.sh. PROBE: diffing after-vs-after at :500 -> 6 cases RED, including both stageCodeReview cases. - FR-007 doc block: moved to immediately precede `private async readVerdict`; asserted by a perl adjacency check in the gate and by a test. PROBE: the HEAD~1 arrangement -> RED. - FR-006 third format: a gateless "no gate" note case plus the three reviewDriven prompt markers and a negative control. PROBE: deleting the third alternative from the filters at :2154/:2186 -> RED (was green before). - dead gateScript: gates/T001-gate.sh created, both gates and both gateScript fields delegate to gates/phase-01-contract.sh (the artifact runTaskGate strategy 1 executes); the BRE alternation is split into two separate grep -q calls. tasks.title: Update ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts
tasks.description:
MODIFY src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts. TR-007: read `src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts` and assert `readVerdict`'s doc comment states the real rule and no longer claims "any open task → NO-GO"

REVIEW FAIL (code): the shared mock contract makes the suite miss the real entry point — FR-008/TR-012.
  WHERE: src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts:111-122
  EXPECTED: `loadTaskStateReturns(before, after)` returns the pre-dispatch snapshot to
    `executeReviewWorkflow`'s `beforeState` regardless of which entry point drives the review, so a
    re-open is detected through `stageCodeReview`/`stageUatReview` — the paths `gwrk ship` calls.
  ACTUAL: "Call 1 is the pre-dispatch snapshot" holds only for a direct `executeReviewWorkflow` call.
    `stageCodeReview` calls `loadTaskState` at src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts:1331 to build
    `phaseTasks`, consuming call 1, so `beforeState` (:429) receives the AFTER state and
    `detectReviewReopens` diffs after-vs-after -> empty set. REPRODUCED: with
    `loadTaskStateReturns(stateWith("completed",{gateScript}), stateWith("open",{gateScript}))` and
    `runTaskGate` passing, `executeReviewWorkflow` -> `state.reviewVerdict === "NO-GO"` (passes) while
    the IDENTICAL state through `stageCodeReview` -> "GO" (fails: expected 'GO' to be 'NO-GO'). The
    D10 block masks this by passing one object as both before and after (:261).
  FIX: key the mock off its argument or count calls per entry point (e.g. return `before` until
    `dispatchToAgent` is called, `after` afterwards) and add a case that drives `stageCodeReview`.
    TR-012 is specified as the runs #2727/#2728 shape end-to-end; written with this helper it is a
    silent false GO — the exact false-green class this feature exists to remove.
  GATE: gates/T002-gate.sh — runs the suite only; no assertion distinguishes the entry points
  REF: plan.md Phase 01; spec.md FR-008, TR-012

REVIEW FAIL (code): the TR-007 doc-comment guard never checks attachment, and the comment is orphaned — FR-007.
  WHERE: src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts:324-330;
    src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts:1412-1421,1461
  EXPECTED: FR-007 requires `readVerdict`'s doc comment to describe what the code does, so the guard
    must assert the block IMMEDIATELY PRECEDES the declaration, e.g.
    /\/\*\*[\s\S]*?NOT "any open task → NO-GO"[\s\S]*?\*\/\s*private async readVerdict/
  ACTUAL: `(src.match(/\/\*\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g) ?? []).find(b => b.includes('NOT "any open task →
    NO-GO"'))` scans EVERY doc block in the file and accepts it wherever it sits. It sits at
    :1412-1421, immediately followed by a SECOND `/** */` block (:1422-1429) documenting
    `detectReviewReopens` (:1431). `readVerdict` (:1461) therefore has NO doc comment: an IDE hover
    shows nothing and JSDoc/TS attribute the correction text to `detectReviewReopens`. plan.md's
    "Verified starting state" table records this as "present (W2) — :1414-1422", so the misplacement
    survived both the plan's verification pass and this new guard.
  FIX: move the block to immediately above `private async readVerdict` and tighten the assertion to
    require adjacency to the declaration.
  GATE: gates/T002-gate.sh — the named-case grep proves only that the test exists, not that it binds
  REF: plan.md Phase 01; spec.md FR-007

REVIEW FAIL (code): D5 guards two of FR-006's three note formats and none of the prompt widening — FR-006/TR-006.
  WHERE: src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts:209-235
  EXPECTED: FR-006 requires the DIAGNOSE filter to match `REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE`, `REVIEW FINDING`
    AND `REVIEW FAIL`, and requires the review-driven prompt to state the build is green and ask for a
    gate or test per fix under a widened persona.
  ACTUAL: only `DIVERGENCE` and `REVIEW FAIL` are covered. `REVIEW FINDING (` is the note W2's own new
    gateless branch writes (ship-orchestrator.ts:1502) — the newest and likeliest to be dropped — and
    nothing asserts the `reviewDriven` block (:2185-2205: "You are a build and code-review
    diagnostician", "## Review Findings (build and gates are GREEN)", "a finding that survives its own
    fix is a finding that will recur"). REPRODUCED: deleting `REVIEW FINDING|` from the regexes at
    :2154 and :2186 leaves all 70 phase tests green and gates/T002-gate.sh exit 0.
  FIX: add a D5 case for a `REVIEW FINDING (T00X, no gate):` description, and assertions over the
    reviewDriven prompt's three marker strings.
  GATE: gates/T002-gate.sh — passes with the regex alternative deleted
  REF: plan.md Phase 01; spec.md FR-006, TR-006

REVIEW FAIL (code): T002's declared gateScript is dead text; the executed gate asserts almost nothing.
  WHERE: specs/028-review-finding-liveness/gates/T002-gate.sh:1-12 vs
    specs/028-review-finding-liveness/.gwrk/tasks.json T002.gateScript
  EXPECTED: the ~20 assertions declared in T002's `gateScript` (build, two vitest runs, cli/webapp
    `diff -q`, the `Gate authority is one-way` / `APPEND ONLY` / `VERDICT CHANNEL` greps, the three D1
    and D10 negative guards, the four named-case greps) form T002's mechanical baseline.
  ACTUAL: `runTaskGate` strategy 1 (src/utils/gate-exec.ts:64-74) unconditionally prefers the
    convention file `gates/<id>-gate.sh` when it exists and returns; T002's field is NEVER executed.
    `gates/T002-gate.sh` only does `test -f` plus one `pnpm vitest run` on the suite. Every content
    assertion is inert — which is why the `REVIEW FINDING|` mutation above left it green while T001's
    inline gate (no `gates/T001-gate.sh` exists, so it falls to strategy 3) caught it.
  FIX: write the declared assertions INTO `gates/T002-gate.sh` (the file is the executed artifact) and
    generate `gates/T001-gate.sh` so both tasks share one baseline. Separately, replace
    `grep -q 'REVIEW FINDING|REVIEW FAIL'` with `grep -qE` or two `grep -q` calls: in BRE `|` is a
    literal, so that assertion currently proves only that the file contains that 27-char JS regex
    source, and refactoring to the equivalent /REVIEW (FINDING|FAIL)/ would turn it red while fully
    satisfying FR-006.
  GATE: gates/T002-gate.sh — the gate itself is the defect
  REF: plan.md Phase 01; spec.md FR-006; specs/024 gate-assertion-contract

tasks.title: Modify ship-orchestrator.ts
tasks.description:
MODIFY src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts. `detectReviewReopens` returns `ReviewFindings` (`reopened` / `descriptionOnly` / `all`) and diffs descriptions against `beforeState`; `readVerdict` takes `ReviewFindings` and consults `.all` before any `continue`, naming the mechanism in its output; the single call site at `:500-501` is updated. Tests: src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts

REVIEW FAIL (code): the executed gate for this task verifies none of Phase 02's Done-When — FR-008 / TR-008.
  WHERE: specs/028-review-finding-liveness/gates/T003-gate.sh:1-12 (the artifact that actually runs); T003.gateScript in this file (never reached)
  EXPECTED: runTaskGate Strategy 1 (src/utils/gate-exec.ts:63-74) prefers the convention file gates/<id>-gate.sh over task.gateScript, so gates/T003-gate.sh MUST execute Phase 02's Done-When: `npm run build`; `npx vitest run src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts`; `... .review-gate-divergence.test.ts`; `... .review.test.ts`; and the five `grep -q` assertions ('REVIEW FAIL (', 'descriptionOnly', and the three named TR-008 cases). This is the same hazard plan.md solved for Phase 01, where gates/T001-gate.sh and gates/T002-gate.sh delegate to gates/phase-01-contract.sh precisely because "a gateScript that repeats the assertions is dead text — the executed artifact is the file".
  ACTUAL: gates/T003-gate.sh is the stale auto-generated stub. Its only assertions are `test -f src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts` and `pnpm vitest run src/engine/ship-orchestrator.test.ts`. That suite has ZERO occurrences of `descriptionOnly`, `ReviewFindings` or `REVIEW FAIL` (verified: `grep -c` returns 0) and never exercises detectReviewReopens. REPRODUCED: a git worktree at cad1f86 (the commit immediately BEFORE Phase 02, where `grep -c 'descriptionOnly|ReviewFindings' src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts` returns 0) runs gates/T003-gate.sh to `PASS: T003`, exit 0, 19/19 tests green. The gate cannot tell FR-008-implemented from FR-008-absent, so Phase 02 has no mechanical baseline at all and any future revert of ReviewFindings ships silently green. The Phase 02 implementation itself is correct — build passes, all three review suites pass (47 tests), gates/phase-01-contract.sh still passes, and all five Done-When greps hit — but none of that is enforced by anything the orchestrator runs.
  FIX: Replace gates/T003-gate.sh with a gate that executes Phase 02's Done-When verbatim (mirror the Phase 01 pattern: either inline the nine commands under `set -euo pipefail`, or add gates/phase-02-contract.sh and have gates/T003-gate.sh delegate to it). Keep the `# AUTHORED` marker (AX-006). Then re-run it against cad1f86 and confirm it FAILS there — a gate that passes on the pre-change commit is not a gate.
  GATE: gates/T003-gate.sh assertion #2 (`pnpm vitest run src/engine/ship-orchestrator.test.ts`) — passes unconditionally with respect to FR-008
  REF: plan.md Phase 02 > Done When; plan.md Phase 01 > Done When (identical hazard, already solved there); spec.md FR-008, TR-008

REVIEW FAIL (uat): Phase 02 Done-When "All tasks pass gates" — T003 was re-closed with an unresolved finding, and its executed gate cannot detect the deliverable. FR-008 / US-004 / SC-005.
  EXPECTED: (a) T003 stays `open` until the REVIEW FAIL (code) block in this description is remediated — the feature's own doctrine is that a green gate never closes a task a reviewer reproduced a defect on; (b) the gate that actually runs for T003 asserts Phase 02's Done-When, so it FAILS on a tree where FR-008 is absent.
  ACTUAL: (a) T003 is `status: "completed"` with `completedAt: 2026-08-25T02:16:05.003Z` while the REVIEW FAIL (code) block is still live and verbatim in this description. `git diff --name-only 19a2ad2 HEAD` and `git diff --name-only HEAD` report ONLY .gwrk/tasks.json — zero source files changed since the NO-GO. The finding was closed by re-running a gate, not by fixing anything. This is the exact failure mode US-004 and SC-005 exist to prevent, occurring on the very task that implements it.
  (b) UAT independently reproduced the code review's gate defect. gates/T003-gate.sh asserts only `test -f src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts` and `pnpm vitest run src/engine/ship-orchestrator.test.ts`. That suite contains ZERO occurrences of `descriptionOnly`, `ReviewFindings`, `REVIEW FAIL` or `detectReviewReopens` (grep -c = 0 for all four). A detached worktree at cad1f86 — the commit immediately before Phase 02, where `descriptionOnly` and `ReviewFindings` are both absent from ship-orchestrator.ts — runs gates/T003-gate.sh to `PASS: T003`, exit 0, 19/19 green. Confirmed via src/utils/gate-exec.ts:63-74 that runTaskGate Strategy 1 prefers the convention file gates/T003-gate.sh over T003.gateScript, so the nine Done-When commands declared in gateScript never execute.
  NOTE: the Phase 02 IMPLEMENTATION itself passes UAT. All nine Done-When commands were executed literally and all nine succeed: `npm run build` exits 0; the three suites pass 29 + 6 + 12 = 47 tests; all five greps hit. readVerdict names the mechanism and consults findings.all. The defect is in verification and task state, not in the FR-008 behaviour.
  See spec.md > US-004, FR-008, SC-005, TC-002; plan.md > Phase 02 > Done When; plan.md > Phase 01 > Done When (identical hazard, already solved there via gates/phase-01-contract.sh).
  Fix: (1) Replace gates/T003-gate.sh so the executed artifact runs Phase 02's Done-When verbatim — mirror Phase 01 by adding gates/phase-02-contract.sh and having gates/T003-gate.sh delegate to it, keeping the `# AUTHORED` marker (AX-006). (2) Re-run the new gate against cad1f86 and confirm it FAILS there; a gate that passes on the pre-change commit is not a gate. (3) Only then re-close T003 — via remediation, not via a re-run.
